Name: Daily Adventures
Author: seekmisery
TagLine: Daily Adventures, English, Russian, SMAPI, UI, Gameplay
Description:
Daily Adventures

Adds optional daily quests and small adventures that fit naturally into Stardew Valley.
Ever wish there was a little more to do each morning when you wake up on the farm? Daily Adventures gives you 1–3 randomized quests every day — gathering resources, catching fish, or running errands for the townsfolk. Nothing game-changing, just a gentle nudge to explore the valley and earn some extra gold along the way.

Features

38 handcrafted quests across three types:
Gathering (18 quests) — Chop wood, mine ore, dig clay, forage seasonal plants, hunt for gems, collect mushrooms, and more. Objectives scale from quick errands (3 spring wild plants) to satisfying challenges (100 wood).
Fishing (7 quests) — Catch any fish or go after seasonal catches. Whether you're a casual angler or chasing the Master Angler title, there's something for you.
Delivery (13 quests) — Bring items to 12 different villagers: Robin needs wood, Harvey wants his coffee, Jas is craving ice cream, Penny would love a diamond… Each delivery feels like a natural part of valley life.
Adventure Board UI — Press F7 to open the Adventure Board at any time. See your active quests, progress bars, rewards, and lifetime stats — all in one clean panel.
Smart quest rotation — Quests are filtered by season and year, so you won't see winter foraging tasks in spring. The mod avoids repeating recent quests to keep things fresh.
Automatic progress tracking — No need to "turn in" quests manually. Chop a tree? Your wood-gathering quest updates instantly. Catch a fish? Counted. Give a gift to the right NPC? Done.
Randomized rewards — Each quest awards gold (scaling with difficulty) or useful items. You never know exactly what you'll get.
Multi-day quests — Some adventures give you 2–3 days to complete, so you're not rushed.
Configurable quest count — Want just 1 quest per day? Or the full 3? Edit 
config.json
 to set your preferred number (1–3).
Save-safe — All progress is saved with your game file. Uninstall cleanly at any time.

Installation

Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or later)
Download the mod and extract the ZIP into your 
Stardew Valley/Mods
 folder
Launch the game through SMAPI
Press F7 in-game to open the Adventure Board

Compatibility

Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0.0+
Works in single-player. Multiplayer has not been tested.
Should be compatible with most other mods. No vanilla files are replaced.

Console Commands (for testing/debugging)

Command	Description
da_status
Shows all active adventures and their progress
da_complete <slot>
Force-completes an adventure by slot number
da_reset
Clears all adventures and generates new ones

Localization

The mod is fully available in English and Russian (Русский). The quest names, descriptions, and all UI text are localized.
Want to add your own language? Copy 
i18n/default.json
rename it to your language code (e.g.),
pt-BR.json
and translate the strings.

FAQ

Q: Can I add this mod to an existing save? A: Yes! It's completely safe to add mid-playthrough. New adventures will appear the next morning.
Q: Can I remove the mod from an existing save? A: Yes. The mod stores its data in SMAPI's save system. Removing the mod won't corrupt your save — the adventure data simply won't be loaded.
Q: How many quests do I get per day? A: By default, 1–3 quests are generated each morning (randomized). You can set a fixed number in the config file.
Q: Do quests expire? A: Yes. Each quest has a duration (1–3 days). Expired quests are removed and replaced with new ones.

Source Code

This mod is open source. Contributions, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome!
